notes.title: Patch for March 20th 2025
notes.content:
The New Big Event

It's been awhile everyone, but we hope you'll agree that this new patch was worth the wait! Today we introduce the EVENT system, the backbone of the next phase of Crystal Rail's development!

Events have been in the works a long time; there were plans as early as 2 years ago, but there was always something more important to do on the game, until now! We hope they will provide a fascinating look into the world of Crystal Rail, and an incredible source of replayability and dynamism! 

Please note: the system is not properly tutorialized at the moment, we hope to add more in-game guidance as necessary in the coming months. All gameplay balance WIP.

For those who wish to avoid spoilers, please dive right into the game, for anyone seeking the details, read on!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
Added the Event System: During the day, you now have a random chance to encounter events at stations. Events appear when you select routes, and can be predicted using foresight. [NOTE: In your first playthrough, events do not happen until turn 5],
Every event poses a story and a choice. Choices affect your resources. If you have certain conductors, you can unlock character-specific choices, usually better ones, for your situation.,
If you leave a station without loading, unloading, or resting, you now trigger a random event.,
As a result of certain events, you can now acquire statuses which prevent you from loading or from resting for the remainder of the day.,
Over 60 new events have been added to the event pool.,

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
New optimizations improve the game's performance and reduce its ram usage.,

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
Pinpointed a memory leak relating to night stations, improving game loading times and reducing ram usage.,

As always, please report your experiences, highlights and suggestions in ⁠the discord or the community tab - we look forward to your thoughts on these new events!

Denn & the CR Team

notes.title: Patch Notes for 23.02.25
notes.content:
This is the final cohesive patch to the demo, implementing new tutorialization to make the experience of learning the game smoother, new UI to help improve the gameplay overall, and a couple fun tweaks for you more experienced players!

We hope you will take this time to try Crystal Rail, tell your friends, and of course send us your feedback as we seek to make the best game we can!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Directorate Government now starts with all commodities being worth 0 instead of 1.
[*] In your first run, subterfuge (slander, blackmail and charity) are now locked until turn 5. Tutorials explaining subterfuge which used to proc around turn 2 are now spread out between turns 4, 5, and 6, which subsequently unlock those functions.
[*] Winning the game now procs unique dialogue
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*] The revolution foresight screen in Auroch's Crossing is reworked, and now separates information on the upcoming government into categories.
[*] New UI clarifies that the number next to your stations is the 'stop order', the order in which you reach each station on your route.
[*] Station supplies now accurately state that you have 'already loaded' after you load, rather than stating that the train is full (which, while true, is irrelevant to the supplies of the station and confused some players)
[*] Station supplies now accurately state that the player lacks capacity, if the player has no train cars which carry the corresponding commodities (previously it simply stated that the train was full, which was mildly misleading and confused some players)
[*] New tutorials are added to your first playthrough clarifying that ranking is determined by capital, and when the final 3 turns begin.
[*] Certain buttons now animate to show interactivity
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted textbox for train descriptions to avoid text overflow
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.31.25
notes.content:
The Public Demo is out now. Beta testers should also see these changes reflected in their builds, but this patch will be the one you remember as the patch which accompanied the first demo.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Buffed loans to start at 25 capital (previously 10)
[*] Adjusted salary calculation for recruitable conductors
[/list]
[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added over 40 new voice lines to the tarpan
[*] Added over 40 new voice lines for the greasefish
[*] Added new videos to tutorials for additional clarity
[*] At your last stop, the depart button will now say "end day"
[*] Adjusted 'Contraband Surrender' header size (note, we are aware of some issues with the button hitboxes, will be fixed soon)
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed glitch preventing the Pangaea train from being unlocked
[*] Fixed glitch where hired conductors would sometimes offer to work for free
[*] Corrected some typos referring to reputation as bonus and capital as score (please continue screenshotting and reporting these)
[*] Reinstated hovertext for car sale area
[/list]

Enjoy your ride,
The CR Team

notes.title: Patch Notes for 18 Jan 2025
notes.content:
All aboard the new year Patch everyone! This is unofficially the demo patch, as it is substantially the patch which will comprise the public demo to release at the end of the month, and includes one of the largest and most impactful changes to the pace of the game!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]After you act at a station, you now see all opponent actions simultaneously, organized by action type. You do NOT see the specifics of their action, only that they gained, lost, or stayed the same. Orange frames mean they gained capital, blue frames mean they gained reputation.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*]New optimization reduces load times and file size
[*]New notifications added which link to wishlist and discord
[*]In rankings, the player is now highlighted in yellow
[*]Stations where you cannot load due to having no capacity now warn your "train is full"
[*]New icon implemented for where your train starts on the route map
[*]Added new dialogue lines for tarpan's tutorials and for pilorie.
[*]Changed UX for loans to animated and highlight where to click
[*]Moved placement of dialogue box to not obscure gameplay
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dhole hill will no longer let you rest without selecting a conductor's ability
[*]Governments can not be rerolled without having revealed the government first
[*]Notification about favors gained from tarpan greene now waits until after the 'night' animation plays
[*]Adjusted timing of some dialogue lines to better reflect dialogue length
[*]Tutorial now prevents players from starting their route without train cars, preventing subsequent soft-lock
[/list]

Sincerly,
the CR Team
